integrity: The result is a self-contained mathematical derivation based on published crossed-square incidence, elementary singular-value decomposition, and exact tridiagonal eigenanalysis. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Historical originality remains subject to earlier equivalent spectral treatments.
limitations: The full general-rank spectrum is expressed through a finite explicit transversal Gram matrix; trigonometric closed forms are proved only for ranks two and n minus one. Loop-erased adjacency and general involutive-matching existence are not treated. The finite checker covers chain lengths up to six.
title: Exact inertia and boundary-rank spectra of the mutual-inverse graphs of finite isotone transformation monoids
